title: Form and register the company
summary: A private company may be formed by one person, but it must satisfy CAMA's registration requirements and cannot be formed for an unlawful purpose.
requirements: Choose a lawful purpose for the company.
Prepare the registration information and documents required under CAMA.
Register the company with the Corporate Affairs Commission before operating as an incorporated company.

citations.quote: One person may form and incorporate a private company by complying with the requirements of this Act.
